title: Loop Quantum Gravity
description: Quantise geometry itself: areas and volumes come in discrete steps, carried by a spin network. Space is woven, not continuous. Unlocks the Spin Network Loom.

puzzle.goal: Where a spin network's link of spin j crosses a surface it gives that surface an area A, in units of the Planck area l, scaled by the Immirzi parameter γ. Write A.
puzzle.name: Quantised geometry
puzzle.ask: Find A in Planck areas for the smallest step, j = @{j}, with g = 0.2375 for γ.
puzzle.method: The area operator acts on each link like the length of an angular momentum: its eigenvalues are √(j(j+1)).
